en: The postcard front shows a black-and-white photograph of a sawmill building complex by a calm lake or river, surrounded by trees. The caption at the top right reads 'SÅGEN VID ÖSTERBY BRUK,' and there is handwritten text at the bottom. The reverse side organizes the handwritten message and address, featuring Swedish text, recipient details, and a reference to Midsummer's Eve 1907.
